name: moneymike-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Mike Garrett: work-order, work-order-jira, night-watchman, moneymike-skills, session-band and bash-lsp.

plugins.name: work-order
plugins.description: The work-order ticket-as-contract specification, reference implementation, file binding, and conformance validator.

plugins.name: work-order-jira
plugins.description: Jira binding for the work-order ticket-as-contract specification.

plugins.name: night-watchman
plugins.description: Unattended-operations engine: dispatch-contract tickets, an owner decision profile, a capability ladder, and the orchestrator/cheap-executor split.

plugins.name: moneymike-skills
plugins.description: Personal workflow skills: PR shipping and review, Jira authoring, research files, UI bug repro on real devices, Datadog monitor and catalog hygiene, GitHub repo hardening, review writing, session retros and writing for agents.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt naming the computer, workspace and project a Claude Code session runs in.

plugins.name: bash-lsp
plugins.description: Bash language server for Claude Code: shellcheck diagnostics after each edit of a shell script, plus go-to-definition and document symbols.
